description: This file contains unit tests for the MyInfoAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM API module. It uses the PHPUnit testing framework to verify API behaviors like fetching data, while other operations are intentionally not implemented and tested for exceptions.

classes.name: MyInfoAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify the behavior of the MyInfoAPI class, especially read operations via 'getOne', and confirming that 'update', 'delete', and validation methods throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MyInfoAPI using data provider cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetOne' method from YAML data file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'update' on MyInfoAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that 'getValidationRuleForUpdate' throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Checks that 'delete' method is not implemented and throws expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a not implemented exception.
